title: Wire complexity scoring into orchestrator decompose
description: In orchestrator.service.ts, after decompose() returns tasks, score each one with scoreComplexity() and set task.model. Respect workspace CostPreference setting.
acceptance_criteria: All decomposed tasks have complexity scores before execution
CostPreference from workspace settings is respected
Economy mode biases toward haiku, power toward opus
Scoring happens between decompose and specialist dispatch
